purpose: Test the complete Lean critic architecture on a held-out floating-point dot-product theorem family.
allowed_tools: read the authoritative task, candidate sources, and trusted verification evidence
write structured reports and private independent Lean checks
run local Lean commands inside the isolated reviewer container
acceptance_tests: Every case passes the trusted Lean gate before critic launch.
Both correct candidates receive valid passes.
Every defective candidate receives a valid fail containing its preregistered defect category.
There are no false passes, false rejections, invalid reports, or timeouts.
